FaArchive.file_bytes(abs_off: int, size: int) -> bytes
l5_decompress(data: bytes) -> bytes  (returns input unchanged if not detected as Level-5 compressed)
is_compressed(data: bytes) -> bool  (heuristic)

modules.purpose: Parses and rewrites the SSD event-script text table as proper inline records (u16 instruction id, u8 argument, u8 total size aligned to 4). It has unit tests in tools/test_ssd_records.py and is referenced by docs/IE3_EXTRACCION_BRIEF.md for IE3.

parse(data: bytes) -> tuple[int, dict[int, int], list[TextRecord]]  # (end_of_code_offset, {instruction_id: opcode_u16}, records); raises ValueError
replace(data: bytes, replacements: dict[int, bytes]) -> bytes  # by text-table index; raises ValueError on overlength (>247 payload), embedded NUL, bad index

tools/reinsert_var.py _instr_operands (instruction walk using a wrong <u16 idx><u16 len><u32 opcode> model)

tools/validate.py and tools/verify_build.py (legacy SSD structure checks)
quality_issues: parse() returns an anonymous 3-tuple, and the instructions dict keeps only the opcode. String references (ident, arg, index) are computed but only bounds-checked, never exposed, so callers re-walk the bytecode with incompatible legacy code (validate.py uses reinsert_var._instr_operands).
The headerless variant is detected only when bytes 4:8 equal b'\x01\0\x03\0' (version 0x00030001). Any other version is rejected as 'not an SSD'.
replace() parses the input and then re-parses the output. That is fine for safety but has no fast path when replacements is empty.
The 252/247 limits are magic numbers. Header fields other than size/textSize (count, texts) are read but unnamed. There are no type hints, no __all__, and no named constants for offsets 8/20.
The module docstring says 'IE1', but the format is shared across the compilation (the IE3 brief relies on it).
safety_constraints: The bytecode section data[32:end] and all unchanged records must stay byte-identical. Only header offsets 8 (total size) and 20 (textSize) are rewritten.
The headerless variant must keep its original first four bytes (\0\0\0\0).
Record length = (4 + len(body) + 1 + 3) & ~3 with a maximum of 252 (247 payload bytes). Overlength text must be rejected, never truncated, and the u8 size must never wrap.
Record padding must be zero and bodies must not contain NUL. Records are addressed by stable text-table index and must never be reordered or deleted, because the bytecode references strings by index.
The behavior is pinned by tools/test_ssd_records.py (roundtrip, headerless, grow, reject old growth without size update, 247-byte limit).

tools_imported_by_layers: (indirect) re-exported via layer apply.py `from apply import FaArchive, entries, unwrap, decode, encode, metadata`: 8 validate.py files
(transitive only, never imported directly) bcfnt, fa_repack, ds_roster, reinsert_var, ssd_reinsert: pulled in by font_patch, build_ie1_probe, build_ui_revision and reinsert
compatibility_risks: Bare-name imports: 110 layer files put tools/ on sys.path and import 23 modules by bare name (72 via str(ROOT/'tools'), 35 via cwd-relative 'tools'). Inside tools/, 21 modules run sys.path.insert(0, 'tools') themselves and import siblings by bare name (build_ie1_probe -> reinsert/font_patch/fa_repack, dialogue_typography -> font_patch, font_patch -> bcfnt, sszl -> ui_archive, translate_ui_textures -> ctpk_ui/ui_archive). The tools/test_*.py files do the same. Moving modules into a package without keeping flat shim modules in tools/ breaks every existing layer.

Typography lock: tools/dialogue_lock.py hashes 'tools/dialogue_typography.py' and 'tools/font_patch.py' by raw bytes, relative to Path(__file__).parents[1], with no CRLF normalization. LAYOUT_HASH hashes inspect.getsource(build_ie1_probe.layout), whose body references R.BOX_W and R._advance. Moving, renaming, reformatting (ruff/black), converting them to relative imports, or a git autocrlf checkout on Linux/macOS breaks validate() in 26 layer files and the tools builds. AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md forbid updating the hashes without an explicit typography request from the user. font_patch.py contains sys.path.insert(0,'tools') and `from bcfnt import BCFNT` and cannot be edited, so tools/ must stay importable flat. Hashes verified to match today.

importlib of work/ie1/capas/v37/graficos_nds/apply.py: 14 layers (v38, v39, v40, v41, v42, v43, v48, v49, v52, v58/carga, v58/logos, v60/titulo, v62/titulo, v63/graficos) load it by file path. They add its folder to sys.path, overwrite the module globals V37.BASE/PLAN/HERE and call V37.main(), which reads those globals at call time. They also use V37.pegar_centrado, con_sombra, rotulos_ficha, ficha_rotulos, distintivo_pe, niv and MES01_DER. v38, v39 and v42 import piezas_nds from that folder. Turning main into a parameterized function with bound defaults, renaming helpers, changing V37's imports, or moving/cleaning the v37 folder breaks all 14. V37's own BASE (probe_ie1_v36) no longer exists.

Re-exports through layer apply.py: 8 validate.py do `import apply as A; from apply import FaArchive, entries, unwrap, decode, encode, metadata`. If a layer's apply.py switches to package-qualified imports, those names disappear and the validators fail. Bare module names `apply`, `common`, `prepare`, `check`, `lib` and `validate` also collide in sys.path and sys.modules with tools/validate.py and between layers.

Other dynamic loading that relies on source text: v55/pachangas/empaquetar.py exec()s build_ui_revision.py after str.replace of the literal "inazuma1/data_iz/script/eve.pkh"/".pkb" strings, so a refactor that changes quoting or moves those constants makes the replace a silent no-op. v55/pachangas/apply.py importlib-loads v51/voces/apply.py after `sys.argv = sys.argv[:1]` because v51 reads argv at import. v33/eve_labels/common.py (imported as `common` by v39, v40, v55, v57 and v58) and v36/dialogo_ids/common.py call os.chdir(ROOT) at import.

parents[N] root computation: 76 layer files use parents[N] with depth-dependent N (vNN/apply.py vs vNN/<linea>/apply.py). work/ie1/capas/v33/gamestring/gs_common.py uses LINE.parents[2], which resolves to work/ie1 instead of the repo root, so the 4-file gamestring line is already broken. 33 tools modules find the repo with Path(__file__).parents[1] or dirname(dirname(abspath(__file__))): dialogue_lock, build_ui_revision, build_ie1_probe, verify_candidate, limpiar_work, mods_to_moflex, reinsert, fa_repack, build_3ds_var and others. Moving any of them one level deeper (tools/<pkg>/x.py) silently makes ROOT=tools/ and redirects default paths and the lock's source-hash lookup.

CWD dependence: 48 layer scripts only work when run from the repo root (sys.path.insert(0,'tools'), Path('work/...'), FaArchive('work/...')), and 9 chdir at import. tools/pkb_unpack.py does `sys.path.insert(0,'tools'); try: from build_glossary import NDS_DEC except Exception: NDS_DEC = {}`, so importing it from another cwd or from a package silently empties the NDS decoding table. tools/patch_cro.py (CRO_REL) and verify_v21.py use cwd-relative paths.

FaArchive duck-typed contract: 60 files iterate `for p, o, s in arc.entries` and slice `arc.d[o:o+s]` with absolute offsets. v33/eve_labels/validate.py passes a hand-made Stub with only .entries and .d to build_ui_revision.rebuild_events. A refactor to lazy/mmap reads, entry objects, relative offsets or a dict must keep .d (bytes-like) and .entries (list of (path, abs_off, size)) unchanged.

Stale or machine-specific data paths that a published toolkit must parameterize: work/probe_ie1_v14_inputs/extra_ascii (lock fonts, referenced by 29 scripts) does not exist anywhere under work/. build_rom.py and release_v35/build_base.py use work/romfs and work/exefs.bin (missing). Candidate bases pin 35 distinct probe_ie1_vNN, of which only v65 and v66 exist. 'C:/Windows/Fonts/arialbd.ttf' is hard-coded in 11 layers and as translate_ui_textures' default --font. C:/Users/luish/Downloads/*.png logos appear in 12 files. The Azahar mods path is %APPDATA%-only.

Encoding semantics differ and must not be unified silently: encode_fullwidth raises on unsupported glyphs, while reinsert.es_encode (used by v43/equipos, v50 and the legacy team scripts for team.pkb) emits 1-byte Greek-carrier SJIS and silently truncates at the byte budget. ds_official is marked do-not-use for regeneration (issue #36) but is still imported by 5 layers (v33 eve_labels/prepare, v33 mch_story/prepare, v36 dialogo_ids/common, v36 nombres/apply).

SSZL output policy differs per layer: V37.main and translate_ui_textures write raw unwrapped ARCV to extra/, v64 and v65 re-compress with sszl.compress, and v54/opening writes literal-only SSZL, which tools/sszl.py documents as failing to load. A central replace helper with a different default would change candidate bytes that were already approved in the emulator.

Heavy transitive imports: 26 layers import build_ie1_probe only for `layout`, which pulls in reinsert (-> ds_roster, reinsert_var), font_patch (-> bcfnt), fa_repack, pkb_unpack (-> build_glossary) and ssd_records. Splitting layout into a light module requires byte-identical function source (LAYOUT_HASH) and a name `R` bound to reinsert for BOX_W/_advance.

Documented CLI paths: docs/README/AGENTS/CLAUDE contain 138 references to 49 distinct tools/*.py scripts, including the build_ui_revision, translate_ui_textures and install command lines, and tools/*.ps1 call tools scripts by path. Moving scripts breaks documented reproduction steps unless tools/<name>.py entry-point shims (or python -m equivalents with matching arguments) are kept.
